thread:
mike: Heads-up — CI publish included a field that looks like a KMS wrapped blob in build-metadata.json. spotted by preflight scanner.

celine: ugh. which image/build? paste path pls.

mike: projects/redwood-ci/containers/shipper/0.3.7/build-983/meta/build-metadata.json
found key: "service_key_enc": "CiQA...ABase64...=="

otto: treat as exposed. if it's KMS ciphertext and exposed in an artifact, assume the SA or key material could be enumerated. plan: rotate creds, revoke old keys, patch CI to never include ciphertext blobs.

sec-bot: @mike flagged artifact: projects/redwood-ci/containers/shipper/0.3.7/build-983/meta/build-metadata.json -> potential wrapped secret. Severity: high.

eng-oncall: immediate steps: 1) snapshot artifact and audit logs, 2) create rotated service account + keys, 3) rotate any downstream secrets (DB/redis) that used this SA, 4) patch CI to reference Vault path instead of embedding ciphertext.

celine: i'm taking DB rotation. otto, can you handle SA rotation and KMS key policy hardening? mike, keep artifact snapshot and do access list.

mike: snapshot copied to gs://sec-incident/3067891234/artifact-meta.json and saved original image digest. running access log query now.

otto: quick lock: removing roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter from non-internal principals on projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci-keys/cryptoKeys/shipper-key. doing a short-lived IAM change and logging it.

sec-bot: IAM change recorded CHG-3067-KMS-LOCK.

celine: DB rotation commands (postgres example):
```
NEW_PW=$(openssl rand -base64 24)
psql -h db.redwood.internal -U admin -c "ALTER USER shipper_app WITH PASSWORD '$NEW_PW';"
# update Vault
vault kv put secret/data/apps/shipper db_password_cipher=@<(echo -n "$NEW_PW" | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=rotate-3067 --key=shipper-rotate-key --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | base64 -w0)
```

mike: audit query returned pulls by internal CI runners and a third-party scanner that does not have KMS decrypt perms. no Decrypt calls found for shipper-key in last 60d. logging export: gs://sec-incident/3067891234/logs.json

otto: created new SA prod-shipper-rotated and new key. wrapped key with a fresh KMS key in keyring rotate-3067. pushed wrapped blob to secret/data/ci/shipper-key-rotated. revoked old SA key material.

eng-oncall: smoke test: deployed new image pointing to rotated secret and performed auth test to DB. success. rolling prod rotation during the 30-min window starting in 25m.

mike: CI patch in flight: replace step that writes build metadata with a pointer to Vault path and strip any env-derived base64 fields. adding a linter rule to fail on KMS header prefixes (CiQA|CiQB).

sec-bot: Suggestion created SEC-3067-DETECT to add artifact registry scanner rule.

celine: follow-ups: 1) add pre-publish lint for artifacts, 2) add Vault policy preventing partner-readable paths from containing ciphertext-like values, 3) run a repository grep for similar blobs in last 90d, 4) postmortem doc and partner communication.

otto: confirmed no external Decrypt calls. still rotating was correct. revoking old key IAM bindings now.

mike: rotation complete, old keys revoked at 16:41 PT. CI patched and new builds published. artifacts removed and replaced.

eng-oncall: incident INC-2026-0723 created and resolved after rotation. queueing tickets for the follow-ups.

celine: thanks team. i'll write the post-incident summary and send to sec-ops. tagging @otto @mike :thumbsup:

mike: closing thread — evidence preserved in gs://sec-incident/3067891234 and retention requested for 90 days. :white_check_mark:
